evidence: The TiN cycle consisted of TDMA T/Ar–H2 purge/NH3/Ar–H2 purge/NH3–Ar–H2 plasma/Ar–H2 purge steps at a growth temperature of 180 8C and a total pressure of 1 Torr. TDMA T was pulsed for 1–10 s and purged with Ar–H2 for 15 s. NH3 was pulsed for 10 s and purged with Ar–H2 for 15 s. The TDMA T flow rate was 35 sccm (carried by Ar 35 sccm).
